transcript: Speaker A (AI): तुम क्या कर रहे हो? [What are you doing?] Speaker B (Man): I eating. summary: An AI avatar corrects a man's English grammar in a split-screen format, showing how the SpeakEasy app teaches correct phrasing. The ad highlights that the app is 10 times cheaper than traditional classes and only takes 15 minutes a day. It ends with a call to action to download the app.
